value.description: The controlled color value of the color picker

default-value.description:
The initial color value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the color value of the color picker.

format.description: The controlled color format to use

default-format.description:
The initial color format when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the color format of the color picker.

open.description: The controlled open state of the color picker

default-open.description:
The initial open state of the color picker when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the color picker.

inline.description: Whether to render the color picker inline

close-on-select.description: Whether to close the color picker when a swatch is selected

open-auto-focus.description: Whether to auto focus the color picker when it is opened

disabled.description: Whether the color picker is disabled

required.description: Whether the color picker is required

invalid.description: Whether the color picker is invalid

name.description: The name for the form input

placement.description: The placement of the floating element relative to its anchor.

gutter.description: The gap between the floating element and its anchor.

same-width.description: Whether the floating element matches the width of its anchor.

skip-animation-on-mount.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

valuechange.description: Handler that is called when the value changes, as the user drags.

valuechangeend.description: Handler that is called when the user stops dragging.

openchange.description: Handler that is called when the user opens or closes the color picker.

formatchange.description: Fired when the color format changes

pointerdownoutside.description: Fired when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

focusoutside.description: Fired when the focus is moved outside the component

interactoutside.description: Fired when an interaction happens outside the component

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the color picker. Useful for composition.

positioning.description: The positioning options for the color picker

initialFocusEl.description:
The initial focus element when the color picker is opened.
Return `false` to skip moving focus, or `null` to use the default.
